meta.title: Meridian — AI 开发工作空间
meta.description: Meridian 将项目、代码库与 AI 协作整合在一个桌面工作空间中。创建项目、编写代码、检查变更，让工作有序接续。

hero.title: AI 开发工作空间
hero.paragraph:
以 Rust 桌面架构为底座，为项目上下文与持续协作设计。
从目标、代码到变更检查，看完整开发过程如何衔接。
hero.headline: 为完整项目而构建

story.title:
从一个想法，
到一份有据可查的成果
story.description: Meridian 将项目、代码库与 AI 协作整合在一个桌面工作空间中。代码、任务与上下文彼此连接，工作可以从上次停下的地方继续。

chapters.label: 项目与代码库
chapters.title: 先有项目，再展开工作。
chapters.description: 创建或导入项目，集中管理文件、分支与变更。

chapters.label: 代码与协作
chapters.title: 目标一致，分工清晰。
chapters.description: 围绕同一目标分工执行，保留上下文，让开发与检查有序衔接。

chapters.label: 检查与交付
chapters.title: 看清变更，再交付。
chapters.description: 对照代码差异与检查结果，修正问题，保留交付依据。

hero.title: AI Development Workspace
hero.paragraph:
A Rust-based desktop foundation, designed for project context and continuous collaboration.
Explore how goals, code changes and review connect across one project.
hero.headline: Built around your entire project

story.title:
From an idea
to work you can review
story.description: Meridian brings projects, repositories and AI collaboration into one desktop workspace. Code, tasks and context stay connected, so work can pick up where you left off.

chapters.title: A project. A place to begin.

chapters.title: Shared context. Focused roles.
chapters.description: Work toward one goal with clear roles and shared context, connecting development with review.

chapters.label: Review & delivery
chapters.title: Review the change. Keep the evidence.
chapters.description: Compare the diff with check results, resolve issues and retain a record of delivery.
